args.sql:
SELECT 
    (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'contqualrate')::numeric AS contqualrate,
    (sc.community_engagement->'network'->>'follcount')::int AS follcount,
    (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'ugcval')::int AS ugcval,
    CASE 
        WHEN (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'contqualrate')::numeric >= 4.5 AND (sc.community_engagement->'network'->>'follcount')::int >= 2000 THEN 'Top'
        WHEN (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'contqualrate')::numeric >= 3.0 AND (sc.community_engagement->'network'->>'follcount')::int >= 1000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'contqualrate')::numeric >= 2.0 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS creator_type
FROM socialcommunity sc
WHERE sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'contqualrate' IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 20;
